subject.title: feat(system-agent): host skills and web-search setup in Ask OpenClaw

question: Should Ask OpenClaw permanently host workspace-skill and web-search provider setup, including chat-initiated dependency installation and masked credential collection, rather than continuing to require the terminal wizards?
rationale: The implementation adds a new high-authority operator workflow rather than repairing an established broken contract; maintainers must explicitly accept its support, security, documentation, and upgrade surface.

options.title: Sponsor hosted setup
options.body: Accept the new Ask OpenClaw capability after redacted real-session proof and a committed user-documentation follow-up.

options.title: Keep terminal-only setup
options.body: Decline chat-hosted skills and search setup so dependency installation and credential collection remain exclusively in existing terminal flows.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Approve only the non-sensitive skills flow and retain web-search credential setup as a terminal handoff until its security and UX contract is separately reviewed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor hosted setup
recommendation.body: Accept the new Ask OpenClaw capability after redacted real-session proof and a committed user-documentation follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context identifies this person as the active author and assignee for the feature, though current-main ownership history could not be inspected.
